CHANGEME
========

This is a [pyobs](https://www.pyobs.org) GUI client for CHANGEME (one line: what it's for, who
runs it), written in CHANGEME (language/framework).


## Documentation

Full docs, including a per-view catalog: https://docs.pyobs.org/projects/pyobs-CHANGEME/


System dependencies
--------------------
CHANGEME: platform packages/build toolchain beyond what the language's own package manager
installs, if any (e.g. Qt, a C++ compiler + CMake for a native client). Delete this section if
there's none.


Install *pyobs-CHANGEME*
--------------------------
CHANGEME: clone + build/install steps in this repo's native toolchain (`uv sync` for a Python
client, `npm install` for a JS one, `cmake --preset ... && cmake --build ...` for a native one).


Running
-------
CHANGEME: the command to launch it and the minimal config it needs to connect to a fleet.
